_comment: RF01 reproduction policy — the RF01 regression test prepares a write-restricted root, canonicalizes it as ROOT, substitutes ${ROOT}, and feeds requests.jsonl lines through checker::check_request with cwd=ROOT so the relative 'tree/…' spellings resolve under it. Patterns are resolved-path prefixes (path_matches_lexical), mirroring FsToolPolicy::new(allowed_paths, denied_paths).
